description: This file defines the SearchProperty interface, which provides methods to build search filters for properties within a JSON-based model. It includes methods for equality, comparison, pattern matching, and membership tests on property values, along with retrieving the property path.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Creates a search filter to check if the property exists.

methods.name: eq
methods.description: Creates a search filter to check if property value equals the given boolean, int, long, double, or String value.

methods.name: ne
methods.description: Creates a search filter to check if property value is not equal to the given value.

methods.name: ge
methods.description: Creates a search filter to check if property value is greater than or equal to the given value.

methods.name: gt
methods.description: Creates a search filter to check if property value is greater than the given value.

methods.name: le
methods.description: Creates a search filter to check if property value is less than or equal to the given value.

methods.name: lt
methods.description: Creates a search filter to check if property value is less than the given value.

methods.name: like
methods.description: Creates a search filter to check if property value matches the pattern.

methods.name: in
methods.description: Creates a search filter to check if property value is in the specified set of values.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path of the property.
